title: 2011 Score - Factory Set Update #352 Justin Houston (RC) KC Chiefs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2011 Score sports trading card features Justin Houston, the linebacker for the Kansas City Chiefs. The card is a part of the Factory Set Update, with card number 352. It is a rookie card and also a part of the base set. The card is in standard size and manufactured by Panini in the year 2011. The card is not autographed and is a part of the National Football League (NFL) league.
